notes: Snapshot limit: the pricing page uses a subscriber-count slider rendered by script; the captured text only shows the free tier ('Absolutely nothing for your first 100 subscribers') and no paid base price for larger lists, so only the free tier is annotated (no plan name is displayed; name_any accepts 'free'). Billing is per active subscriber (usage-like). The twelve '+$9/+$29/+$79 /month' items are add-ons, not plans. The 50% non-profit discount is a discount, not a plan. The profit calculator on the paid-subscriptions page ($4,971/mo vs Substack etc.) is an illustrative simulation, not a price. 'Beehiiv, Ghost, and Substack' are migration sources, not integrations. 'We're profitable, self-funded' and 'used by tens of thousands of people every month' are company statements, not payment proof. 'A small team ... fully remote' gives no employee count and no country. The Markdown page quotes John Gruber about 'formatting instructions'; that is not instruction-like text aimed at AI.
